column3: Change our Saturday hours to 8 to 3, we're staying open later now.
Put the cinnamon roll price up to $6.
A few things: make the top bar a darker brown, add "Gluten-free loaf, $11" to the menu, and change the home page headline to "Baked by hand since 2019".
The page view counter should also remember the date of someone's last visit. Nobody needs to see it, it's just for us.
Can you tidy up the order form code? It's messy. Don't change how it works.
Write a draft page about our December holiday hours (closed the 25th and 26th, short days 8 to 12 on the 24th and 31st), but don't put it on the site yet.
Our phone number changed to 555-0199. Please update the website.
We're opening on Mondays now, 7 to 3. Update everywhere on the site that says when we're open.
When someone sends an order, the thank you message should say we'll call within the hour.
Add a "Find us" link on the contact page that opens Google Maps for 14 Mill Street, and stop the visit counter from running on the order page.
